2. Ask the caller where they are and what happened
3. Put the incident in and send units
4. Watch them drive there on the map. If they need backup they radio you

A short training shift teaches the basics.

You get a grade at the end of each shift and earn money for more units and new parts of the city.

The Deadliest Game of Simon Says You Will Ever Play. 

🚨 Use Code "RELEASE" for 1,000 Cash

You wake up in a prison with no memory of how you got there. To survive, you follow Simon's orders — but only when he says "Simon Says." Get it wrong and you die. No one knows what Simon really wants, or why you're here. Outlast everyone, and maybe you'll find out.

🎮 Full controls in Settings → Mobile HUD Editor, PC Keybinds, Controller Binds. Don't like them? Rebind or Rebuild every one.

93% Never Make It Out, Good Luck

games.name: [CHAPTER 2] FATHOM
games.description:
CHAPTER 2 IS OUT NOW

!! Your progress automatically saves! You can start at where you left off when you come back. !!

Fathom Amusement shut down its underground park after an “incident”. Tonight you’re breaking in.
Uncover the truth in STORY MODE, or jump straight into the hunt in CHASE MODE. HE CAN HEAR YOU.

He’s awake. He climbs walls, crawls through vents, and hears everything: your footsteps, your chat, even your voice on the mic. Talk to the monster and he talks back. Just watch what you say.

Grapple to escape. Flash your camera to blind him. Hide in a locker and don’t make a sound.

Solo or up to 4 players. Stay quiet. He’s listening.
